languageModelTools.name: winccoa_list_managers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all WinCC OA managers in the current project with their status (running/stopped). Use this when the user asks about managers, processes, or what's running in the WinCC OA system.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_datapoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for datapoints in the WinCC OA system by pattern. Supports wildcards (*). Use this when the user asks about datapoints, data, values, or wants to find specific system elements. Examples: 'System1:*', '*Pump*', 'ExampleDP_Arg1.'

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_value
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current value of a specific datapoint element in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks for the current value, state, or status of a specific datapoint. The datapoint must be specified in the format 'System:DpName.Element' (e.g., 'System1:Pump.state').
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get current value of a datapoint element

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_dptypes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists datapoint type definitions in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks about datapoint types, structures, or data models. Supports pattern matching with wildcards.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_manager_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets detailed status information for a specific WinCC OA manager by name. Use this when the user asks about a specific manager's details, configuration, or state.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get detailed status of a specific manager

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_execute_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executes a WinCC OA CTL script file via the Script Actions extension. Use this when the user wants to run a script, execute a test, or trigger a script with arguments. The script must exist in the workspace.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Execute a CTL script with optional arguments

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the script

winccoa.mcp.logLevel.description: Log level for MCP Server Extension output
enumDescriptions: Show all messages (debug, info, warnings, errors)

winccoa.mcp.autoReconnect.description: Automatically reconnect to MCP Server when connection is lost

winccoa.mcp.reconnectRetries.description: Number of reconnection attempts before giving up (0-10)
